decision.reason: [ev-522e37356d1b] is one changelog line saying LogQL "introduces pattern match filter operators" and linking to PR 12398. It doesn't name the operators or their syntax. It also doesn't say whether they are on by default, need configuration or a feature flag, or affect how existing queries are parsed or behave. So applicability, the open aspect, can't be written from this evidence. We need the PR or the LogQL documentation for these operators to say what was added and who is exposed.
